_readme: Corrections to data/registry.json, applied by scripts/registry.py after matching on every run. Each operation is idempotent. Ops: {"op":"merge","from":ID,"into":ID} | {"op":"rename","id":ID,"name":TEXT} | {"op":"set_status","id":ID,"status":STATUS,"date":"YYYY-MM-DD"} | {"op":"set_location","id":ID,"lat":N,"lon":N,"location":"Place, State, US","precision":"city|county|state"} | {"op":"hide","id":ID} | {"op":"alias","id":ID,"alias":TEXT} | {"op":"split","id":ID,"headline_ids":[ID,...],"new_id":ID}. See README.
